The canonical Ethereum sUSN proxy 0xe24a3dc889621612422a64e6388927901608b91d reports sUSN and resolves to 0xef2ea4250b7ce4d0aa9ca70607ecef278c6eab15, whose pinned runtime equals the Sourcify exact-match StakingVaultOFTUpgradeableHyperlane runtime; _update is whenNotPaused and rejects blacklisted senders or recipients. owner()=0x1ea169ecccf7714e7ba04900e1a3357cca77327f, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,owner)=true, hasRole(BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE,owner)=false. The BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE has no current member: Etherscan logs show one RoleGranted at block 21130318 (2024-11-06) to 0x173806021b18c4e60170e412dc88f991eb00d699 and one RoleRevoked at block 21836233 (2025-02-12); hasRole for that account and for the owner both return false, and a simulated blacklistAccount call from the owner reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount. The owner can grant the role and pause() succeeds in simulation, so the Ethereum deployment is a direct Possible (global pause plus admin-authorizable blacklist), not a Yes. The asset verdict is set on Base: proxy 0x34a2798d47b238a7cba9d87d49618dee6c4d999f reports symbol sUSN and resolves to verified StakedUSNHyperlane 0xa02ca8c6130b75b320faa785034e95d4374a8942; its owner 0xf56d33ef52642ce226A566610A979DC8d954592D (3-of-N Safe) holds BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, a simulated blacklistAccount(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) from that Safe succeeds, paused()=false, and _update reverts BlacklistedAddress for blacklisted from/to. Supply measured across six deployments totals 34,785,785.28 sUSN: Ethereum 27,416,373.28, Base 6,236,386.24, Berachain 1,007,004.91, HyperEVM 125,658.47, zkSync 215.59, Sophon 146.79. Base is 22.75% of the canonical Ethereum supply and 17.93% of the six-deployment sum; either reading is material. Unread Starknet/Citrea/Tac coverage remains unresolved, and the zkSync and deprecated Sophon deployments are not aggregated into an all-deployment certificate. Upstream USN reserve access is separate.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Noon documents Ethereum sUSN as the canonical ERC-4626 wrapper and lock chain: sUSN inventory is locked on Ethereum, destination Hyperlane representations mint on accepted messages, and return transfers burn the representation before Ethereum unlocks the original. The zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are bridge representations, while Ethereum bridge configuration, pause/correction, upgrade, mailbox/ISM, and destination owner controls are scored here separately from native deposit-gated issuance.
